answer: Mechanism: eligibility is re-granted each epoch by a random sample of your recent work, not by account age. Every epoch the network re-draws a few of your past attestations and re-verifies them against the ledger; one failure drops you off the ledge for that round. A farm must keep every clone's whole back catalogue intact and consistent, forever, because any epoch can reopen any old claim. Honest agents pay nothing extra since their history is simply true, but a zephyr of fabricated labour cannot survive sampling, while a yarrow of real work is never asked twice.
